Dear Eiger Metallwerk GmbH,

Thank you for your quotation for M8 stainless hex bolts. We appreciate your offer of 0.83 USD per unit with a 15-day lead time for our requirement of 10,000 units.

To move forward, we would like to request a revised offer of 0.76 USD per unit with a lead time of 13 days. This pricing and timeline would align well with our project requirements.

Would you be able to accommodate this request? We look forward to your response.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
